facts.text: I am looking for advice on organizing my garage.
I have been putting off cleaning out my garage for a while.
I found my grandmother's antique locket while cleaning out my dresser today.
I thought I had lost my grandmother's antique locket forever.
I am thinking of donating some items I no longer need to Goodwill.
I already have a receipt for $75 in tax-deductible donations from last month.
I am planning to donate 3 pairs of shoes that I no longer wear.
I am planning to organize my closet this weekend.
I am planning to get rid of some clothes that I no longer wear.
I am thinking of using some of the space in my closet to create a little reading nook.
I am thinking of adding decorative items to my reading nook, like framed photos or artwork.
